name: ancestors-engine
description: Engine per archivi genealogici in YAML: validatore, paradati, registro delle ricerche e generatore di siti statici con profilo pubblico protetto
author: Emmanuele Villa

scripts.build: tsc && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('dist/generator/assets', {recursive: true}); fs.cpSync('src/generator/assets', 'dist/generator/assets', {recursive: true});"
scripts.example:site: npm run build && cd example && node ../dist/cli/index.js build --profile private -o ../dist-example
scripts.example:site:public: npm run build && cd example && node ../dist/cli/index.js build --profile public -o ../dist-example-public
scripts.prepare: npm run build && (git config core.hooksPath .githooks 2>/dev/null || true)
